entryHint: Cards you want to buy: collectors offer them and bring them to the store

store.title: Buylist
store.intro: List the cards you buy and at what price. Nearby collectors who own them get an alert and offer them to you; drop-off and payment happen in store.
store.importHint: Columns: name (or set and number), quantity, minimum condition, cash price, credit price.
store.empty: The list is empty. Add the cards you want to buy.
store.planText: Publish the cards you buy: nearby collectors who own them get an alert and bring them to your store.

sell.title: Sell to stores
sell.intro: Nearby stores looking for cards in your collection. Offer your copy: if the store accepts, you bring it in and get paid in store (cash or credit).
sell.empty: No nearby store is looking for your cards yet. The more cards in your collection, the more requests you'll find.
sell.adultsOnly: Selling to stores is for adults only.
